_comment: Copy to sources.json (gitignored) and fill in. Everything specific to your company lives here.

sources.label: Outsourced SDR
sources.how_to_check: Search the vendor's replies ledger by surname stem AND company. Quote the prospect's own words with the date. Pull every other row at the same company for account context.

sources.label: Outbound campaign reply
sources.how_to_check: Look the email up in your sequencing tool; if no hit, search contacts by surname. List every campaign they are in with first and last contacted dates.

sources.label: Intent / signal tool
sources.how_to_check: Match on name or LinkedIn URL in the signal tool's export. Report the signal, its score and the date.

sources.label: Event or referral
sources.how_to_check: Search the event attendee lists and the inbox for the name and company domain, last 120 days.

sources.label: Website inbound
sources.how_to_check: Check the form backend only if the meeting came through the booking link and nothing above matched.

outreach._comment: A personal follow-up (connection request, note) only goes out when the primary source is one of these and no source owns the account.
